title: Create request (input, contract v0)
description: A request to agentspace lease create. The v0 CLI takes it as flags and arguments only and never reads this document; it defines the request for validation, and for the hosted API (#0011), which takes it as JSON. Tolerant in form (any case, surrounding whitespace, null for not given) and strict in meaning (unknown members and ambiguous values are refused). The TTL's range, 1 minute to 24 hours, is checked after parsing, not here. See docs/lease-api.md.

project.description: Letters, digits and '-', 1 to 32, starting and ending with a letter or digit, in any case.

platform.description: os/arch or os/arch/variant in any case; the arch MAY be aarch64, x86_64 or x86-64. Null or absent means linux/arm64.

profile.description: name or name@version in any case; the version is 1 or more, leading zeros allowed. Null or absent means agent-linux.

size.description: 1 to 8 letters and digits in any case. Null or absent means m.

ttl.description: A duration with units. Null or absent means 8 hours.

Short form (8h, 90m, 1h30m, '2 hours'; units d, h and s in any case and m in lowercase only, or their words in any case, largest first, each once, with optional whitespace between and around them) or ISO 8601 P[nD][T[nH][nM][nS]] in any case. A bare number, an uppercase M in the short form, weeks, months, years and fractions are refused.
